crew.overview: The inspiring true story of Richard Montañez, the Frito Lay janitor who channeled his Mexican American heritage and upbringing to turn the iconic Flamin' Hot Cheetos into a snack that disrupted the food industry and became a global pop culture phenomenon.
crew.title: Flamin' Hot

details.biography:
A graduate of AFI and a previous apprentice of Editor John Axelrad, Kayla was named someone to watch in VARIETY’S BELOW THE LINE IMPACT REPORT and STAGE 32 WOMEN TRAILBLAZERS.

Kayla’s feature work as an Editor includes THE IMMIGRANT, dir. James Gray; Don Cheadle’s critically acclaimed MILES AHEAD for Sony Pictures Classics; Lorene Scafaria directed dramedy THE MEDDLER; Lake Bell’s sophomore directorial feature I DO... UNTIL I DON’T; The Netflix feature CANDY JAR directed by Ben Shelton; RIDE directed by Jeremy Ungar for Unified Pictures and RLJ Entertainment.
details.name: Kayla Emter
